text:
maya: Quick async status — putting together a short sprint pulse for runtime perf work. TL;DR: kernel PR ready for review, continuous-batching canary looks good, KV-warmup latency win but some churn on evictions. cc @simon @jun @devon :eyes:

simon: Kernel side — PR is open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1287. Main change is hop-by-hop scheduler + micro-op fusion. Bench on my laptop: p50 12ms -> 9ms for short seq. Need 1 reviewer from eng-runtime core.

jun: KV cache warmup experiment (branch kv-warmup-v2): warmup reduces cold-start p95 by ~42% on toy traces. Caveat: eviction counters spike on 128-concurrent clients in canary. Data in this gist: https://gist.github.com/jun/kv-warmup-stats

devon: FYI infra dep — we're still waiting on the CUDA 12.2 node images from eng-infra. If that lands mid-week our perf numbers should be stable; otherwise there may be a perf skew vs CI. Pinged infra @sre#infra.

anita: Tests: I'm seeing intermittent flakes in trace_replayer that touch the KV eviction path. Repro steps are small but failing ~1/30 runs. I opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/872. Need someone to pair on repro and add a flake guard.

maya: Ownership ask — can we confirm: Simon owns kernel PR review, Jun owns KV warmup rollout, Anita to triage test flakes, Devon to follow infra image ETA. I'll own coordinating the canary and docs update. If anyone needs support call it out here. :+1:

ops-bot: canary-deploy: runtime-canary cluster updated to image runtime:v2026-04-kvwarm. All pods restarted. Canary health: 8/8 ready.

qa-bot: perf-monitor: p95 latency spike detected at 11:35 UTC in canary (up +18% vs baseline). Correlating logs: increased eviction churn reported.

jun: digging into the eviction churn now. My initial hypothesis: warmup uses more prefix cache memory transiently which pushes eviction thresholds. Working on a short patch to make eviction LRU windows adaptive.

simon: I'll try to get a kernel PR reviewer by EOD. Also posting a small perf trace to the PR comments for context. Requesting @anita to add a unit test that covers the micro-op fusion edge case.

anita: ack, will add a test and try to reproduce the flake with a higher timeout. If I can't repro by tomorrow I'll ask for a quick pairing session.

devon: infra update: eng-infra replied — CUDA images are queued, ETA ~48 hours. I'll post when images are in. If that slips we'll run the canary on a mixed cluster and label the results.

maya: next steps: (1) Simon finish reviewer + merge kernel PR once green, (2) Jun push adaptive eviction patch to canary, (3) Anita force-repro and add flake guard, (4) Devon update infra images and mark metrics with node-type. I'll do a status check tomorrow morning and open a short postmortem if we see regression persist. Thanks all — no meeting unless someone requests one. :coffee:
